content: Mawari wewiwame 'Ewari hɨriyaritsie
Muitsexi meta 'ukirawetsixi 'ixaheritsixi yunaime teɨteri mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: «Xekenaye'atɨa naime 'ikɨ 'aitsikate hikɨ temɨxeyetɨirie.
Kepauka Kurutani hatuxameyaritsie xemanukɨne, meta 'ari xeheutahaxɨaximetɨ kwie Yawé xekakaɨyari mɨxeyetuirietsie, mana tetexi xepanɨkɨtɨkɨ 'anenekame, naxi xepitiwirieni,

mɨkɨtsie naime 'aitsikate xepa'utɨaxɨani. Mɨpaɨ xepɨteheyurieni kepauka xemanukɨne Kurutanitsie, kepauka xemɨ'axɨani kwie Yawé xekakaɨyari mɨxeyetuirietsie, hakewa waɨkawa retsi meta xiete mexuawetsie, Yawé xekakaɨyari xetutsima kemɨtiwarutahɨawekai.
Kepauka xemanukɨne Kurutanitsie, mɨkɨ tetexi 'Ewari hɨriyaritsie paitɨ xekanitiyatsakuni, naxi xekanitiwiriekuni, yemekɨ hikɨ kenemɨtixe'aitɨa.
Manata xepitawewieni tetexikɨ mawari wewiwame Yawé xekakaɨyari hetsiemieme, tetexi tepɨakɨ xixiyatɨkaime xepukayurieni, matsi tetexi nanaimimekɨ pɨta,
mɨkɨtsɨ mawari taiyame Yawé hetsiemieme tetexi yeuta miemekɨ kaniyutawewiwamɨkɨ. Mana hetsiena mawari xepɨtataiya Yawé xekakaɨyari hetsiemieme,
mana 'aixɨa memɨteyuxeiyanikɨ mawariyari xepɨwewieni, meta xeyutemamawietɨ xepɨtekwani Yawé xekakaɨyari hɨxie.
Mawari wewiwame tetexiyaritsie naime 'aitsikate waɨkawa yuhekɨkɨakamekɨ xepa'utɨaxɨani».
'Axakememu'itɨarie 'Ewari hɨriyaritsie
Hikɨ Muitsexi meta rewitsixi mawari wewiwamete yunaime teɨteri mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: «'Ixaheritsixi, kayuwatɨ xekeneumaka, xekeneu'enana. Hikɨri Yawé xekakaɨyari teɨterimama xekanakɨne.
Kemaine Yawé xekakaɨyari xekeneu'enieka, yaxeketenekahuni 'aitsikateya kemaitɨka, hikɨ ne kenemɨtixe'aitɨa».
Muitsexi 'ana kwitɨwa tukaritsie teɨteri mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani:
«Kepauka xemanukɨne Kurutanitsie, 'ikɨ yayupaɨmetɨ nuiwarite Keritsini hɨriyaritsie mepɨyuhayewa mana 'ixaheritsixi 'aixɨa memɨwayurienikɨ: Tsimehuni, Rewi, Kura, 'Itsakaxi, Kutse meta Wenikamini.
»'Ikɨta hipatɨ 'Ewari yemuriyaritsie mepukuyaxe, 'axamemɨ'itɨarienikɨ memɨtaxata: Xuweni, Kahari, 'Atsexi, Tsawuruni, Rani meta Nepɨtahari.
»Rewitsixi yamepɨtiyuani, karima me'utiniutɨ, 'ixaheritsixi yunaime mɨpaɨ mepɨtewatahɨawe:

“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane kɨye kakaɨyariyari mɨtawewieni, yatɨni kɨye xixiyakame yatɨni tepɨakɨ wewiyakame, meta xɨka 'awie hawaikɨ heitakeni. Mɨkɨ tewi pɨtiwewiyaya, 'ayumieme Yawé mɨtixani'erie pɨtihɨkɨ”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane yupaapa yatɨni yumaama mɨkawa'enieni”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane yu'iwa kwieyatsie manuyeyeikani”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane mɨkaheuniere huyetana mɨti'itaiya”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane timaitɨtɨtɨ heitserie kememɨtehexeiya mɨwananaimaka 'ateewa kiekatari, nutuite meta wiuraxi”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane yupaapa 'ɨyaya hamatɨa mɨkahuni, mɨkɨtsɨ mɨyamɨtiuyuri yupaapa 'utaya 'axakaniuyurieni”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane tewatsiekame mukumayɨani”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane yutaru hamatɨa mukahuni, yupaapa yatɨni yumaama niweya hamatɨa”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane yuwarɨkaɨ hamatɨa mɨkahuni”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane yuhepaɨ tewi mumieni 'awie”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane ti'iwatɨ xeime mɨmieni 'atsikatiyurienekame”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
“'Axake'u'itɨarieni kemɨ'ane yamɨkatikayani heitseriemekɨ 'ikɨ 'inɨari niukiyaritsie”. Yunaitɨ teɨteri mɨpaɨ meke'utiyuani: “'Aixɨa pɨ'ane”.
